nights.title: Morat
nights.name: Morat
nights.extract: Morat is a Colombian Latin pop rock band formed in the country's capital city, Bogotá. The band is made up of Juan Pablo Isaza, Juan Pablo Villamil, and the brothers Simón Vargas and Martín Vargas. Drummer Alejandro Posada was also a founding member of the band, but left in 2016 and was replaced by Martín Vargas.

nights.title: Los Angeles Azules
nights.name: Los Ángeles Azules
nights.extract: Los Ángeles Azules are a Mexican musical group that plays the Mexican Cumbia genre, which is the style of cumbia adopted in various Mexican regions.
